workingTreeNote: The tests ran against the uncommitted reconstructed tree identified by the input hashes, not solely against this base commit.
supportingInputsNote: Helper drivers and campaign fixtures are hashed at completion. Unlike the main input manifest, these are not a before-and-after comparison.
method: Execute the built offline application script and its actual event handlers inside the Node vm modeled DOM supplied by tools/test-ui-runtime.mjs.
Prepare campaign checkpoints through public simulation commands and pilot helpers; import serialized saves into fresh application contexts.
Use actual modeled DOM click, key, pointer and animation-frame handlers for the asserted UI segments.
Branch tests import separately prepared decision and pre-extraction checkpoints. They do not claim a continuous full mission played solely through UI handlers.
Validate true extraction crossing, first-report reward uniqueness, independent replay, persisted source facts, interrupted work and thermal lock feedback.
limits: No native browser or CSS layout validation; Canvas calls are modeled no-ops in this suite.
No native focus/dialog, actual file download, browser localStorage, audio playback or physical touch/controller validation.
The touch auto-aim test executes pointer handlers in the DOM model. It is not a touch-device reception.
No human gameplay, comprehension, duration or feel approval is inferred.
